Lina: Heads up 1 May 24 webinar draft: "Operational Patterns for Production LLMs". Need: final headline, run-of-show skeleton, rehearsal time, captions, and exact lead routing. Two timezone options: 9am PT / 12pm ET or 11am PT / 2pm ET. Thoughts?
Marco: I vote 9am PT 0: better overlap with EU PMs.
Rhea: 9am PT works. Also recommend a quick consent slide for recording + a captions plan.
Owen: Speakers: Owen (runtime), Claire (customer story), Luis (benchmarks). Ill make a 5-slide demo checklist for the moderator.
Claire: Confirmed. I'll present a short case-study and 2 ROI bullets. Need PV numbers from @Luis.
Luis: PV numbers incoming, I'll add a chart. Also prepping a 60s pre-recorded demo as fallback.
Lina: Rehearsal slots: Wed 10am PT or Thu 11am PT. Which is best?
Claire: Wed 10am PT OK. Prefer earlier rehearsal.
Marco: Wed 10 fine.
Rhea: I'll own captions: Otter.ai -> VTT -> one-person QC -> upload to /marketing/webinars/ops-llm/assets.
Owen: For routing, we need a single utm and two buckets: enterprise-interest -> ae-enterprise, demo-requests -> webinar-sdr. Proposed utm: ops-llm-may24. Example payload (ops can parse): `utm_campaign=ops-llm-may24&source=webinar&route=ae-enterprise&tags=webinar,ops-llm`
Lina: Deck deadline Tue EOD. Upload path: /marketing/webinars/ops-llm/. Also, recorder + captions vendor confirmed.
Luis: Will upload demo clip to assets and the PV chart by Mon.
Marco: I'll draft social + email copy after deck is final. Target announce Tue morning.
Rhea: I'll run caption test during rehearsal and estimate QC time.
zoom-bot: Meeting created: "Operational Patterns for Production LLMs - Rehearsal" Wed 10:00 PT. Invites sent.
Lina: Locking decisions: live 9am PT (12pm ET), rehearsal Wed 10am PT, deck Tue EOD, utm ops-llm-may24, routing as above, captions Otter + QC. Action owners: Rhea captions, Owen moderator checklist, Luis assets, Marco promo. Closing thread, will post run-of-show here shortly. :rocket:
